versions.changelog:
Initial release of github-actions-docs skill.

- Answers GitHub Actions workflow questions with guidance grounded in the latest official GitHub documentation.
- Helps classify requests into categories like syntax, runners, security, deployments, and migration.
- Always prefers direct links to authoritative pages on docs.github.com/en/actions.
- Provides example YAML or step-by-step instructions only when necessary or explicitly requested.
- Ensures accurate, up-to-date answers by referencing docs before responding—avoids answering from memory.
